{{Quote|One of my hunters has gotten himself into a bit of a pickle, I'm afraid. While exploring what he thought was an abandoned tusk-cat den, he uncovered a nest of nightspiders.|[[Sloan Rusper]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LSR" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''hunter''' lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] on the moon [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] with [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Sloan Rusper]].<ref name="SWG:LSR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of the hunter]]
The hunter was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LSR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because this character spawned under the generic "hunter" template, his name and appearance were randomized among 120 possible depictions after each server reset.<ref name="SWG:LSR" />
